removals.signature: pub use gpui_component::{ Disableable, GlobalState, InteractiveElementExt, StyledExt, Theme, ThemeMode, WindowExt, init, locale, measure, measure_if, set_locale, };
removals.reason: Raw Longbridge utility trait bundle was removed from the app facade; Moon-facing exports cover supported application use.
MoonRoot is now the real root type; Root remains only as a backward-compatible alias.

removals.signature: pub fn header(mut self, header: impl IntoElement) -> Self
removals.reason: MoonPopupMenu::header now takes its height as a first argument, header(height_ui, element). A pinned header is held outside the scrolling rows, so its height must come out of the row list's budget, and the virtualized list is sized in pixels before its siblings are laid out and cannot measure it. Pairing the height with the element makes the declaration unavoidable: the one-argument form left the height at zero, which pinned the header to zero height and rendered it invisible.

removals.signature: pub fn render_with_palette(self, p: MoonPalette) -> impl IntoElement
removals.reason: MoonTabStrip overflow persists a ScrollHandle via window.use_keyed_state, so render_with_palette now takes Window and App. The palette-only form could not keep the handle across frames and recreated scroll state every paint.

removals.signature: pub fn render_with_theme(self, p: MoonPalette, tokens: MoonThemeTokens) -> impl IntoElement
removals.reason: Same as render_with_palette: the themed path is the one that lays out overflow, so it takes Window and App to persist the keyed ScrollHandle instead of building a new one each frame.

removals.signature: pub fn size(mut self, size: MoonCheckboxSize) -> Self
removals.reason: Checkboxes moved onto the shared MoonSize scale, so size now takes impl Into<MoonCheckboxSize> and accepts a MoonSize tier directly. Existing MoonCheckboxSize arguments still compile; Compact and Normal remain as deprecated aliases for Sm and Md.

removals.signature: pub fn size(mut self, size: MoonButtonSize) -> Self
removals.reason: Buttons moved onto the shared MoonSize scale, so size now takes impl Into<MoonButtonSize> and accepts a MoonSize tier directly. Existing MoonButtonSize arguments still compile; Micro, ToolbarCompact, Action, Toolbar and Pill remain as deprecated aliases for Xs, Sm, Sm, Md and Md.

removals.signature: pub use foundation::{StyledExt, ThemeMode, h_flex, init, v_flex};
removals.reason: The re-export gained MoonSize so the shared size scale is reachable as moon_ui::MoonSize; nothing was removed from it.

removals.signature: pub fn size(mut self, size: MoonToggleSize) -> Self
removals.reason: Toggles moved onto the shared MoonSize scale, so size now takes impl Into<MoonToggleSize> and accepts a MoonSize tier directly. Existing MoonToggleSize arguments still compile; Compact and Normal remain as deprecated aliases for Sm and Md.

The re-export gained MoonToggleMetrics so the toggle's resolved per-tier metrics are reachable as moon_ui::MoonToggleMetrics, which is what lets a consumer measure a toggle it does not draw instead of mirroring its geometry by hand; nothing was removed from it.

removals.signature: pub fn menu_size(mut self, size: MoonMenuSize) -> Self
removals.reason: Menus moved onto the shared MoonSize scale, so menu_size now takes impl Into<MoonMenuSize> and accepts a MoonSize tier directly. Existing MoonMenuSize arguments still compile; Compact and Normal remain as deprecated aliases for Sm and Md — which renders one tier larger than the old Compact/Normal geometry (20px/24px rows become 24px/32px).
